tasks.label: tmp-get-dockerconfigjson-secret
tasks.command: kubectl get secret artifact-registry-pull-secret -n deliver-eats -o jsonpath='{.data.\.dockerconfigjson}'

tasks.label: tmp-decode-dockerconfig-host-username
tasks.command: $raw = kubectl get secret artifact-registry-pull-secret -n deliver-eats -o jsonpath='{.data.\.dockerconfigjson}'; $cfg = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($raw)) | ConvertFrom-Json; $cfg.auths.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{host=$_.Name; username=$_.Value.username} } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

tasks.label: copilot-step4-post-user-status-body-v2
tasks.command: $body = '{"name":"asdasd","email":"pruebascliente@gmail.com","password":"12345678","role":"CLIENTE"}'; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://34.36.97.164/api/users' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 45; Write-Output $r.Content; Write-Output ("HTTP_STATUS:" + [int]$r.StatusCode) } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $resp = $reader.ReadToEnd(); $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; Write-Output $resp; Write-Output ("HTTP_STATUS:" + $code) } else { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message; Write-Output 'HTTP_STATUS:000' } }

tasks.label: copilot-step4-post-user-status-body-v3
tasks.command: $body = '{"name":"asdasd","email":"pruebascliente@gmail.com","password":"12345678","role":"CLIENTE"}'; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://34.36.97.164/api/users' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 45; Write-Output $r.Content; Write-Output ('HTTP_STATUS:{0}' -f [int]$r.StatusCode) } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $resp = $reader.ReadToEnd(); $code = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; Write-Output $resp; Write-Output ('HTTP_STATUS:{0}' -f $code) } else { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message; Write-Output 'HTTP_STATUS:000' } }
